info.title: AfriScore API
info.description:
Consent-gated identity, financial data, operations and intelligence infrastructure for African businesses.

All successful responses use JSON. Protected endpoints take either an `x-admin-token` header (control plane) or an `x-api-key` header (partner API); the scheme required by each operation is documented on that operation. Errors use a flat envelope: `{ "error": <stable string code>, "message": <human readable>, "request_id": <correlation id>, ... }` where extra fields such as `details`, `required_scope`, `matched_intent`, `detail` or `path` may be present for a specific endpoint. Every response also carries an `x-request-id` header (echoing a caller-supplied `x-request-id` when it matches the expected format).

get.description: Process-only liveness probe. Deliberately does not touch the database.
Runs a cheap `SELECT 1` (3s timeout). Returns 503 when the database is unavailable so a load balancer can drain the instance.

503.description: Database check failed or timed out

post.description: Returns the raw API key exactly once; only its hash is persisted.

201.description: Client and its one-time API key

get.description: Never returns key material — only id, name and lifecycle timestamps.

200.description: Client revoked; its key can no longer authenticate

post.description: The previous key stops authenticating immediately; the new key is returned once.
Creates a business in `pending_verification` status and appends `business.created` to its ledger.
Runs the configured checks, updates status and trust score, and appends audit entries to the ledger.

200.description: Verification checks and the updated business

get.summary: Get a consent-gated business trust record
get.description: Requires an active consent grant from the business to the calling API client covering the `trust_score` scope. The response is minimised: KYC identifiers are never returned, and ledger event data is projected through a per-event-type allowlist.
Re-walks the hash chain, checks sequencing and validates the HMAC head anchor. A nonexistent business is a 404 (not an empty-but-valid chain).

post.description: Historical transactions are retained; the account can no longer be synced. Idempotent.
Deduplicates on (account_id, external_id), so re-syncing is safe. The whole batch is ingested in one transaction.

get.description: Requires an active consent grant covering the `financial_profile` scope for the calling API client.

post.description: Runs exact, tolerance and installment matching. Only completed credit transactions not already matched to another invoice are eligible; the run is atomic and every claim is conditional, so one payment cannot settle two invoices.

get.description: Requires an active consent grant covering the `insights` scope for the calling API client.

200.description: Overdue invoices, cash-flow forecast, unusual transactions and customer concentration

post.description: Requires an active consent grant covering the `query` scope, plus the scope governing the data the matched intent exposes (for example `invoices` or `insights`). A narrow `query` grant cannot read a financial profile or trust score.

200.description: Grounded answer with the underlying structured data

post.description: Raw national ID and phone number are never stored — only salted hashes. The response contains the hashes.
Checks name/identifier presence and duplicate national-ID registration, then updates status.

200.description: Verification checks, duplicate flag and the updated person

get.summary: Get a consent-gated person trust record
get.description: Requires an active consent grant from the person to the calling API client covering the `trust_score` scope. Returns presence booleans, never the cross-linkable identifier hashes.

post.description: `scope` is one or more capability scopes (`all` grants every scope). An optional `expires_at` must be an ISO 8601 timestamp with an offset and in the future; expired grants are treated as inactive automatically.

delete.description: Idempotent: revoking an already-revoked grant returns it unchanged and does not append another audit event.

post.description: Returns the per-subscription signing secret once. Deliveries are signed with `x-africore-signature` (hex HMAC-SHA256 over `${timestamp}.${body}`) plus `x-africore-timestamp` (unix seconds). Targets must be HTTPS URLs with no port, credentials or private/IP-literal hostname. Event patterns are validated against the known event catalogue.

201.description: Subscription with its one-time signing secret

get.description: The signing secret is never returned by list.

200.description: Subscriptions owned by the calling API client

post.description: Issues a new signing secret for a subscription owned by the calling API client. The previous secret stops validating immediately. The new secret is returned once.

200.description: Recorded webhook events, newest first (capped at 50)

post.description: Fires one synthetic signed delivery (`webhook.test`) at the supplied URL so a receiver can verify signature handling. The outbound HTTP status code is deliberately not returned; only whether delivery succeeded, plus the signature and timestamp used. Signatures are hex HMAC-SHA256 over `${timestamp}.${body}`.

200.description: Delivery result and the signature/timestamp that was sent

ApiKey.name: x-api-key
ApiKey.description: Partner API key. Proves caller identity; consent checks use the server-derived client name, never a caller-supplied header. Per-client rate limit: 120 requests/minute.

AdminToken.name: x-admin-token
AdminToken.description: Bootstrap control-plane credential (AFRISCORE_ADMIN_TOKEN, minimum 32 characters). Independent of partner API keys.

WebhookId.name: id
WebhookId.description: Webhook subscription UUID owned by the calling API client

BadRequest.description: Invalid input (validation failure or malformed JSON)

legal_name: String must contain at least 2 character(s)

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid admin token / API key

value.message: The API key is invalid or revoked.
A valid x-admin-token header is required.

ConsentRequired.description: No active consent grant with the required scope for the calling API client

example.message: Active consent granting the required scope is required.

Conflict.description: Conflicting state, e.g. the provider account is already connected

example.message: This provider account is already connected to the business.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the 1 MB JSON limit

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limited. The global per-IP limiter allows 600 requests/minute; API-key operations also have a per-client limit of 120 requests/minute.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current window resets

RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the window resets

AdminNotConfigured.description: AFRISCORE_ADMIN_TOKEN is missing or shorter than 32 characters on the server

example.message: Admin authentication is not configured on this server.

Error.description: Flat error envelope. `error` is a stable machine-readable code; extra fields are additive and endpoint-specific.

request_id.description: Correlation id, also returned as the x-request-id header

required_scope.description: Consent scope required by the endpoint (403 responses)

api_key.description: Raw API key, returned exactly once
New raw API key, returned exactly once

national_id_hash.description: Salted SHA-256 of the national ID; null when not supplied

phone_hash.description: Salted SHA-256 of the phone number; null when not supplied

duplicate.description: True when the national-ID hash is already registered to a different person

external_id.description: Provider transaction id; unique per account

amount.description: Absolute amount in the currency's minor-unit-exact NUMERIC(18,2)

skipped_duplicates.description: Transactions already ingested for this account

expected_counterparty.description: Payer name/phone expected for this invoice; reconciliation lowers confidence when the paying counterparty disagrees

paid_amount.description: Amount actually received (can differ within tolerance)

deviation_from_mean.description: Standard deviations from the business's own mean transaction size

share_of_total_pct.description: Share of realized revenue, rounded to 0.1%

answer.description: Grounded natural-language answer computed from structured data

grantee.description: API client name the grant is issued to

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp with offset; must be in the future. Expired grants are treated as inactive automatically.

scope.description: JSON-encoded array of granted scopes (as stored)

event_pattern.description: Known event type (transaction.created, account.connected, account.disconnected, invoice.paid) or a group prefix such as transaction.*

target_url.description: HTTPS URL with no port, credentials or private/IP-literal hostname

secret.description: New signing secret returned exactly once

delivered.description: Whether the outbound delivery received a 2xx response

error.description: Failure reason when not delivered; the outbound status code is deliberately not exposed

brokenAt.description: Id of the first entry that failed verification

anchored.description: Whether a keyed head anchor was present and checked

data.description: Per-event-type allowlisted projection; sensitive fields are omitted
